notes: P02 DIMVA-X08_splitter deliverable for venue dimva: evaluation/venue2027/dimva/group_split.py implements the strict independent cross-domain holdout split(groups, seed) -> Partitions for RQ2. Unit of inference is one campaign group, never an individual event (GATES/INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL.md section 3). Identity bridges — shared attacker_family, shared tenant, shared canonical tooling template (case/separator paraphrases like 'Probe-Tool.01' vs 'probe_tool_01' are canonicalized and bridged) and shared source_lineage — are merged via deterministic union-find into leakage components; components are shuffled with random.Random(seed) and allocated 0.6/0.2/0.2 by largest remainder with a no-empty-split repair pass, so the same (groups, seed) always yields byte-identical partitions (partition_sha256 over the assignment). A LeakageAudit returns the exact pre-split bridge findings (kind, attribute, group_ids, raw_values) and a post-hoc bridge-overlap report; split() fails closed with RC_BRIDGE_OVERLAP_DETECTED if any bridge ever spans splits, and the independent detector detect_bridge_overlaps() recomputes overlaps for any (groups, assignment) pair. Event-level split attempts are REFUSED as leaky with RC_EVENT_LEVEL_SPLIT_REFUSED (duplicate group_id records or several group records sharing one campaign_id are event fragments of a single campaign and must never be spread across partitions); other stable reason codes: EMPTY_GROUPS, MISSING_GROUP_FIELD, UNKNOWN_GROUP_FIELD (reason-code/attacker-label side channels fail closed), INVALID_GROUP_FIELD, INVALID_SEED, INVALID_SPLIT_RATIOS, DEGENERATE_COMPONENT_COUNT (bridges collapsing below three components), INCOMPLETE_ASSIGNMENT, UNKNOWN_ASSIGNMENT_KEY, INVALID_SPLIT_LABEL. evaluation/venue2027/dimva/test_group_split.py (22 tests) proves positive vectors: determinism (same seed byte-identical, different seed changes layout), every group assigned to exactly one split with no group spanning two splits and all three splits non-empty, default and custom ratio allocation, family/tenant/tooling/lineage bridge merging, template-paraphrase near-duplicate bridging, transitive bridge-chain collapse, audit exactness and clean state, JSON-serializable versioned output — and adversarial vectors: event-level split refused (duplicate group_id AND shared campaign_id), two campaigns from the same attacker family/tenant asserted to stay in one split with both bridges flagged in the audit, forced leaky assignment producing an exact overlap report (family + tenant bridges with their split labels), empty/unknown/missing/malformed fields, invalid seed/ratios, and total bridge collapse refused. Commands: pytest exit 0 (22 passed); uvx ruff@0.7.1 check exit 0; full evaluation/venue2027/ suite exit 0 (1283 passed) — no regression. Proof emitted via agent_protocol.build_report(task_id='DIMVA-X08_splitter') with real log_paths and validated ok:true; report + logs committed together with the work per established repo convention.
